title: alkhder at ImageEval 2026 Shared Tasks: Constrained Selection and Rotation-Averaged Logit Scoring for Multimodal Hallucination Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.22515v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We describe our submission to Subtask~1b of ImageEval 2026. The task consists of selecting the single visually valid statement from three candidates paired with an image, and is in both English and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). Our system uses a pre-trained 7B vision--language model in a zero-shot setting, without task-specific training or fine-tuning. We formulate the task as a constrained selection problem and choose the answer using next-token log-probabilities. To reduce answer-position bias, we apply a Latin-square rotation to the candidate statements. Our system achieves CI scores of 0.0510 on the English test set and 0.0960 on the MSA test set, reducing CI relative to the official 3B baselines reported on devtest by 83.7\% and 80.4\%, respectively.

translated_title: alkhder参与ImageEval 2026共享任务：面向多模态幻觉检测的约束选择与轮转平均Logit评分
translated_abstract: 我们描述了参加ImageEval 2026子任务1b的提交方案。该任务要求从与图像配对的三个候选陈述中选出唯一在视觉上有效的陈述，任务同时涵盖英语和现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）。我们的系统在零样本设置下使用预训练的70亿参数视觉-语言模型，无需任何针对任务的训练或微调。我们将该任务形式化为一个约束选择问题，并利用下一词元的对数概率来选择答案。为减少答案位置偏差，我们对候选陈述应用拉丁方轮转。我们的系统在英语测试集上取得0.0510的CI分数，在MSA测试集上取得0.0960的CI分数，相对于开发测试集上报告的官方3B基线，分别将CI降低了83.7%和80.4%。
tldr: 该方法在零样本设置下利用7B视觉-语言模型，通过约束选择、下一词元对数概率评分和拉丁方轮转消除答案位置偏差，在ImageEval 2026多模态幻觉检测任务的英语和阿拉伯语测试集上均将CI错误率相比官方3B基线降低超过80%。
en_tdlr: A zero-shot 7B vision-language model system combining constrained selection via next-token log-probabilities with Latin-square candidate rotation to eliminate position bias, reducing CI by over 80% relative to 3B baselines on both English and MSA hallucination detection test sets in ImageEval 2026.
